surroundings.description: How the decorative, non-playable area outside this map is drawn. It never enlarges the tactical board or changes movement/canonical state. Continue extends the nearest authored edge, fill uses one chosen terrain, and blend deterministically mixes that terrain into the continued edge. Automatic is the legacy spelling of continue; solid and manual remain readable for older projects.

color.description: Exterior colour in #RRGGBB form. Required for solid mode.

depth.description: Number of non-playable terrain cells drawn beyond every map edge. A depth of three guarantees coverage for the current PC camera.

terrain.description: Manual perimeter terrain in row-major outer-rectangle order, omitting cells inside the playable map. Its exact required length is (width + 2*depth) * (height + 2*depth) - width * height. These cells are never visitable because they remain outside the tactical dimensions.

terrainId.description: Terrain used by fill, or introduced gradually by deterministic natural blend.

visualVisibility.description: Presentation-only cells that begin visually covered and uncover around friendly units that enter them. This never changes movement, targeting, AI, line of sight, objectives, or canonical battle state. It can describe rooms in one or several buildings today and leaves room for broader exploration looks later.

revealRadius.description: Manhattan distance, in map cells, uncovered around a friendly unit standing in a covered cell. Revealed cells stay visible for the rest of that battle.
